_no_journal_note: ENGINE-GATE record: buying the Vault-Tec voice module from Eldridge is NOT a journal quest and NOT barter — vanilla sells it through a SPECIAL dialogue branch, ncEldrid {420}-{482} (the module is not in his inventory: Node022 creates it out of thin air; the caps check sits on the VISIBILITY of the options; the one-shot is the bitmask LVAR4&512). It cannot be onboarded as an atom (there is no clean node: the debit, the handover and the gsay are smeared across several; the engine checks caps on option visibility and Node973 ignores the result of the debit; LVAR4 is a bitfield while setlvar writes an absolute value). The record exists for routing.node_roles: the special branch is tagged with the special_buy role by ENGINE TARGET — free dialogue walks the player along the REAL options, where the caps, the haggling and the handover are entirely engine-side. Key gvar 350: it is READ by Node019 of that very branch (a text variant; the positional name in .GAM is GRUTHAR_DSTATUS, a vanilla off-by-one for the intended JULES_ELDRIDGE 349 — trust the number and the fact that it is read).
name: Нью-Рино — голосовой модуль Vault-Tec у Элдриджа (спец-ветка, не журнальный гейт)
_maps_note: NEWR1 (Virgin Street) — Eldridge's gun shop. The map number is for reference; this record drives no journal prompts.

npcs._giver_note: nceldrid = Eldridge, the New Reno gunsmith. 'giver' is nominal — this is a special purchase, not a quest.

brief: Голосовой модуль Vault-Tec (PID 356, прото-цена 3000) продаётся у Элдриджа ТОЛЬКО через особую ветку диалога: «что-нибудь особенное» ({255}) → показ модуля → цена $3000 (опция видна при кэпсах >= 3000) или торг до $2500 (Barter-ролл, ветка Node980). Списание и выдачу делает движок в нодах Node973/979/Node022 (one-shot LVAR4|=512). НИКОГДА не продавать модуль прозой/pay_caps/trade_buy.

stages._src: gvar 350 == 0: the record's reference key (Node019 reads it to pick the branch's text variant). The fact that the module is still unsold lives in the script's LVAR4&512, not in a gvar.
the record's terminal state (nominal; the engine tracks the sale with the LVAR4&512 bit, the gvar takes no part).

node_roles._src: the entry to the special branch: option {255} 'something special' (visible while (LVAR4&512)==0, Node005 @0x35b8-0x35fe) -> Node018 @0x4b68 {420}, showing the module.
{423} -> Node019 @0x4c42 (line 430 + an IQ variant; the text variant reads gvar350).
{436}/{437} -> Node020 @0x4d78 {450}/{451}: the caps check sits on the VISIBILITY of the options (item_caps_total(dude)>=3000 @0x4da0; the haggle option {457} at glob35==19 AND caps>=1500 @0x4e56).
{452}/{386} -> Node973 @0x69f6: item_caps_adjust(dude,-3000) @0x6a02 + (self,+3000) -> call Node022 (handover + one-shot LVAR4|=512 @0x5014 + create_object_sid(356) @0x5030).
{457} haggle -> Node980 @0x6670: roll_vs_skill(Barter,0); crit or CH>8 -> LVAR4|=2048 + caps -1500; success -> Node021 {470} $2500.

completion.condition: The purchase is entirely engine-side, through REAL surfaced options (3-4 option_index picks: {255}->{423}->{436}->{452/386}, or the haggle branch): the caps gate on option visibility, the debit in Node973/979, the handover + one-shot in Node022 (LVAR4|=512, create_object_sid 356, add_mult_objs_to_inven). The brain writes NOTHING — the special_buy role only walks the model along the branches (the escort_join/pay class: routing by ENGINE TARGET, not by text).

items: Computer Voice Module (PID 356) — for caps, at the branch's engine price
reward.notes: Not a reward — a purchase. anti-invention: no discounts or gifts beyond the vanilla branches.

anti_invention: The module is NOT sold in prose: no pay_caps/gift_item/trade_buy for it — only the scripted options of the special branch (the engine checks the caps itself, debits them and hands the module over).
The branch names the price: $3000, haggled down to $2500 through a REAL Barter roll (Node980) — the model does not haggle in prose.
Without >= 3000 caps the purchase option simply does NOT exist (an engine visibility gate): state the price honestly, do not invent instalment plans.
After the sale (LVAR4&512) the {255} entry disappears — there is one module and no second.

verified.adversarial_refute: The atom route is refuted by three irreducible facts (there is no clean node; the caps are not enforced by the node — Node973 ignores the return value of item_caps_adjust; the LVAR4 bitmask cannot be expressed with setlvar). The option route = vanilla mechanics as they are.
